facts.fact: The telecoms regulators of Burkina Faso, Mali (AMRTP) and Niger signed a cooperation convention creating the Conseil des regulateurs du Sahel, covering harmonised rules, free roaming, border spectrum coordination and joint positions in the ITU; the article gives no signing date, so its published date 2026-09-26 is used.

systems.owner: ARCEP Burkina Faso, AMRTP Mali, ARCEP Niger
systems.tiers: national telecoms regulators of the three AES states
